build_stanford_online_products_dataset: build a tfds dataset builder for Stanford Online Products with image, class_id, and super_class_id features
create_Builder: create a GeneratorBasedBuilder class for the Stanford Online Products dataset with version 1.0.0
run_Builder_info: run the Builder _info method to return dataset metadata with FeaturesDict containing class_id, super_class_id, and image
run_Builder_split_generators: run the Builder _split_generators method to download and extract the dataset and generate train and test splits
run_Builder_generate_examples: run the Builder _generate_examples method to parse CSV files and yield image examples with class labels
